run_clm_fine_tuning: run causal language model fine-tuning on a dataset without using the HuggingFace Trainer
parse_clm_training_args: parse command-line arguments for causal language model fine-tuning with dataset, model, and training options
load_and_tokenize_dataset: load a dataset from HuggingFace Hub or local files and tokenize it for causal language modeling
group_text_chunks: group tokenized text into fixed-size blocks for efficient causal language model training
configure_weight_decay_optimizer: configure an AdamW optimizer with weight decay applied to all parameters except layer norm and bias terms
